fields.sections[].id: section id; key inside the chunk files
fields.sections[].label: short name of the section
fields.sections[].dataset: public dataset the section comes from
fields.sections[].citation: publication and data records to cite
fields.sections[].accession: repository record and file of the section
fields.sections[].license: reuse license of the data record
fields.sections[].sourceSection: name of the section in the dataset
fields.sections[].nSourceSpots: capture spots of the section that passed the authors' quality rule and were used
fields.sections[].changes: what was changed relative to the source data (required by the license)
fields.sections[].nSpots: number of spots shown (bins of merged capture spots); length of x, y, spotsPerBin and regions.spot
fields.sections[].binUm: bin width in micrometers (same as binWidthUm)
fields.sections[].binWidthUm: bin size along x in micrometers
fields.sections[].binHeightUm: bin size along y in micrometers
fields.sections[].coordUnit: unit of x and y (um = micrometers)
fields.sections[].yDown: true: y increases downward, as in the tissue image
fields.sections[].widthUm: width of the section's bounding box in micrometers (x runs from 0 to widthUm)
fields.sections[].heightUm: height of the section's bounding box in micrometers (y runs from 0 to heightUm)
fields.sections[].x: bin center x per spot, micrometers from the left edge of the bounding box
fields.sections[].y: bin center y per spot, micrometers from the top edge of the bounding box
fields.sections[].spotsPerBin: number of capture spots merged into each spot shown (1 to 4)
fields.sections[].regions.labels: region names (the authors' spatial domains, grouped and renamed)
fields.sections[].regions.kind: per region: tumor, pancreas (non-tumor pancreas tissue) or other
fields.sections[].regions.source: per region: the authors' domain labels it combines
fields.sections[].regions.count: per region: number of spots shown
fields.chunks: URLs of the score files, relative to the site root
fields.chunkCollection: per chunk: collection of its sets (H, PROGENY, REACTOME, WIKIPATHWAYS, GOBP or KEGG)
fields.sets: gene-set id (as elsewhere on the site) -> [index into chunks]; only scored sets are listed
fields.metabolic: KEGG pathway id (as in the metabolic pathway table) -> [index into chunks]
fields.genesUsed: section id -> set or pathway id -> number of its genes measured in the section
fields.notScored: section id -> {sets: gene-set ids of the site that were not scored (fewer than 5 member genes measured), metabolic: pathway ids without a measured enzyme gene}
fields.chunk file: {meta, sets: {id: {section id: {lo, hi, q}}}}; q = base64 text of one unsigned byte per spot in the order of x and y; value = lo + byte / 254 x (hi - lo); byte 255 = not scored
fields.sections[].regions.cellTypes: per region: reference cell types of the site whose tissue the region is (empty: none)
fields.sections[].regions.description: per region: the authors' description of the domain(s) it combines
fields.sections[].regions.note: which of the authors' domains were merged, and the authors' qualifiers that the short labels cannot carry
fields.sections[].genesMeasured: number of genes measured by the probe set of the section
fields.sections[].ribosomalProteinGenesMeasured: number of ribosomal protein genes (RPL*, RPS*) among the genes measured
fields.genesTotal: section id -> set or pathway id -> denominator of genesUsed: genes of the set in the gene-set library; for a pathway, enzyme genes linked to its reactions in the KEGG reaction-to-gene table
fields.genesListed: section id -> pathway id -> [enzyme genes listed in the metabolic pathway table (genes present in the bulk data) that are measured in the section, number listed]
fields.regionSummary: section id -> {sets, metabolic: {scored, lowest[], highest[]} = number of sets / pathways whose mean score is lowest / highest in each region (mean of the shipped scores over the areas of a region); topTranscriptShare: {genes, byRegion[] = share of all counts of a region taken by its ten most abundant genes, acinarTopGenes}; cellTypeMatch: per reference cell type {sets = scored sets of pdac-genesets.json whose activity is highest in that cell type, highestInRegion = how many of them have their highest region among regions, regions = indices of the regions of the cell type}}

meta.scoring: Signaling and functional gene sets: for each spot, expression is log(1 + counts per 10,000) and the score is the t-value of the slope of a univariate linear model of the expression of all genes measured in the section on set membership (PROGENy: on the signed pathway-response weights). This is the definition used for the estimated profiles on this site, applied to the genes measured in the section; gene-set library version 1.0.0. Sets with fewer than 5 member genes measured in the section are not scored. Metabolic pathways: expression of the pathway's enzyme genes = mean of log(1 + counts per 10,000) over the pathway's enzyme genes measured in the section; this is not the metabolic model's activity. Scores are relative within a section.
meta.metabolicLabel: expression of the pathway's enzyme genes

sources.what: tissue section: counts and spot positions

sources.what: enzyme genes of the metabolic pathways
sources.record: KEGG reaction-to-gene table of the metabolic model library used for this site; reactions per pathway as in the metabolic pathway table

sections.licenseSource: License field of the Zenodo records 19304282 and 19305449: cc-by-4.0, open access (https://zenodo.org/api/records/19304282, https://zenodo.org/api/records/19305449; read 2026-11-19)
sections.platform: 10x Genomics Visium CytAssist, FFPE tissue, human whole-transcriptome probe set v2 (18,085 genes), 11 mm capture area
sections.tissue: Surgical resection of a human pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (primary tumor, pancreas)
sections.changes: Capture spots merged 2 x 2 (counts summed) and scored by Cellaris; region labels are the authors' spatial domains, grouped (four fibroblast domains as Fibrous stroma, three acinar domains as Acinar tissue) and renamed, by majority of the spots in each bin (ties: the region with more of the bin's counts).

labels: Tumor, poorly differentiated, with extensive fibrosis
description: Authors' domain PDTumor: regions of poorly differentiated tumor with extensive fibrosis. Tumor cells and fibrous tissue share these areas.
Authors' domain PanIN/GLTumor: gland-forming tumor and tumor-associated PanIN, which the authors could not tell apart by expression and combined.
Authors' domains Acinar1 to Acinar3: enriched in acinar and acinar-to-ductal metaplasia transcripts.
Authors' domain Ducts: enriched in ductal and acinar transcripts.
Authors' domains Fibro1 to Fibro4 (fibroblast-enriched). The authors found Fibro2 enriched in tumors, Fibro1 around fat and Fibro4 in spots with many mitochondrial transcripts.
Authors' domain Perivascular: pericyte-enriched, around vessels.
Authors' domain TLS: T cell and B cell-enriched; tertiary lymphoid structures by histology.
Authors' domain Adipose: overlaps adipose tissue.
regions.note: Regions are the study authors' spatial domains, grouped and renamed. Fibrous stroma combines their four fibroblast domains (Fibro1 to Fibro4), one of which (Fibro2) they found enriched in tumors; Acinar tissue combines their three acinar domains. In the poorly differentiated tumor region, tumor cells and fibrous tissue are not separated. The numbers are the areas per region.
